name: Oozora Momo
source:
She is the youngest sister of the three Oozora sisters. She is calm and endearing.

For those who like Loli, the value of her undeveloped body is infinite!

She is one of the mascot's from Otenki Studio. She is 14 years old.

[From [url=https://www.konbuni.com/nangoku.html]official site[/url]]
